commit_message:
[Tracy] Add colored external GPU zones and GPU zone annotations (#25306)

Adds three functions to the Tracy GPU tracing API.

One of them allows to specify the color of the zones and two of them
allow to create annotations on GPU zones. I use these for a different
plugin and they are useful to display values from PMU counters on
previously defined GPU zones.

Assisted-by: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5)

commit_message:
[Integrate] Update torch-mlir to ba6c16a6 (#25309)

Updates torch-mlir from its November 4 upstream baseline to
[`llvm/torch-mlir@ba6c16a6`](https://github.com/llvm/torch-mlir/commit/ba6c16a6fbcd92c0a46759aacf31a324ccdf28a1),
using
[`iree-org/torch-mlir@ba6c16a6`](https://github.com/iree-org/torch-mlir/commit/ba6c16a6fbcd92c0a46759aacf31a324ccdf28a1)
(`sm-iree-integrates/torch-20261120`).

The integration branch is plain upstream torch-mlir with no extra
commits. The previous one only bumped torch-mlir's own LLVM and
StableHLO submodules, which IREE does not use. This revision builds
against IREE's current LLVM without changes.

ONNX op test expectations:

- `test_div_uint8` is now an expected compile failure on Vulkan.
llvm/torch-mlir#4896 fixed uint8 division to use `arith.divui`, and the
SPIR-V conversion does not support `arith.divui` on emulated i8
(#25316). The test passed before only because its inputs are below 128,
where signed and unsigned division agree.

The `sharktank_tests :: cpu_task` failure is unrelated. The job fails to
download the test artifacts from Azure (`AuthorizationFailure`), and
main (14e6942619) fails the same way.

Assisted by: Claude

Signed-off-by: Roberto Laudani <laudani@roofline.ai>
name: publish_website
